This subsite documents the reusable engineering surface of the **FSPP Research Workbench**: runtime requirements, validation gates, source/data boundaries, and publication build conventions.

## Engineering Documents

- [Architecture](architecture/) — repository shape, package boundaries, and monorepo/subsite design.
- [Environment](environment/) — Python, Node, uv, Quarto, and local virtual environment expectations.
- [Validation Gates](validation/) — checks required before commits, publication, and research-data changes.
- [Repository Workflow](repository/) — GitHub issue contracts, branch defaults, PR checks, and Pages setup.
- [Publication Build](publication/) — GitHub Pages rendering model and generated-output policy.
- [Boundaries](boundaries/) — shared infrastructure, project theory, canonical data, and generated artifacts.

## Repository

- Source repository: <https://github.com/ashitaka-emishi/fspp-research-workbench>
- Published site: <https://ashitaka-emishi.github.io/fspp-research-workbench/>
- Python package namespace: `fspp_workbench`

## Operating Rule

The engineering subsite describes how the Workbench is built and verified. It does not override `AGENTS.md`, project codebooks, or research authority files.
